children: Arcturus Therapeutics reported interim Phase 2 ARCT-810 data showing improved ammonia and glutamine biomarkers and unveiled LUNAR 2.0 with >30-fold higher protein expression.
ARCT-810 Phase 2 interim: generally safe and well tolerated, reduced or maintained first-morning fasting ammonia within normal range.
ARCT-810 reduced glutamine; participants at 0.5 mg/kg achieved mean glutamine within normal range during treatment.
LUNAR 2.0™ next-gen delivery showed >30-fold (reported 38–40x) higher protein expression in NHP studies vs prior lipids/platforms.
ARCT-2601, using LUNAR 2.0, to be integrated into the ongoing Phase 2 OTC study near year-end for ages 12+, per FDA feedback.
Arcturus to acquire myNEO (expected close in October) to strengthen AI-driven mRNA design and target identification capabilities.
